articles.title: Tehran Dismisses Oman's Strait Plan, Escalates Gulf Tensions
articles.description: Iran has rejected Oman's proposal for shared control of the Strait of Hormuz, derailing efforts to ease tensions in the Gulf. Tehran insists on sole control over key routes, complicating U.S.-Saudi strategies. Rising conflicts, including strikes on oil tankers and facilities, accompany surging oil prices.

articles.title: South Korea's Kospi share index falls 7% and other Asian shares are mixed as oil prices surge
articles.description: Asian shares are mixed but South Korea’s Kospi share index is trading about 6% lower on prolonged selling of chipmaking shares. Oil prices jumped more than 2%. The latest rout in Seoul was led by a nearly 13% plunge for shares in chipmaker SK Hynix after its profit in the last quarter fell short of analysts' forecasts even though it soared sixfold. Shares in its bigger rival Samsung Electronics dropped almost 8%. On Tuesday, shares were mixed on Wall Street. The S&P 500 added 0.2% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average jumped 1%. The Nasdaq composite slipped 0.2%.

articles.title: India bonds tiptoe along ahead of Fed meet; oil prices weigh
articles.description: Indian government bonds traded range-bound early Wednesday as investors awaited the Fed's rate decision. Oil prices climbed, reviving concerns about the Gulf conflict and global economic impact. The Reserve Bank of India's policy decision is due next week, with rates expected to remain unchanged. India's financial conditions have tightened recently due to oil price surges. Economic growth is expected to slow while inflation surpasses the central bank's target.
